verdict.rationale: Weave records token usage and cost for each call and shows it in the trace tree and calls table. It also groups traces into Threads and sessions, which implies cost can be viewed per session. However, the evidence never shows attaching custom metadata (e.g., user IDs or feature tags) to calls, or rolling up cost by such attributes. Missing for 10: documented custom metadata or attributes on calls, cost aggregation by user or feature, explicit per-session cost rollups, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
